scope: One developmental structural/argument pass plus the author's subsequent explicit request for a firm universal-basic-income position. Chapter openings, architecture, endings, targeted applications, core conditions and concluding sequence assessed. Not a fresh line-by-line review of the complete book.
thesis: Success can close the comparisons needed to explain success; the specified comparison budget links allocation chances to an information/precision limit on productive attribution.
novelty_boundary: Distinctive proposed economic formulation, bound and attribution interpretation; no claim that incomplete learning, reinforcement, counterfactual thought, epistemic monopoly or UBI are newly discovered. Bounded search does not certify mathematical or historical priority.
policy_bridge: Independent discovery and shared productive participation are public objectives. Access duties address threatened closure; corrective charges need demonstrated external costs; capability finance addresses missing resources; universal income rests on an explicit equal shared claim rather than proof of equal individual counterfactual damages.
ubi_boundary: Hyperscale and concentration alone do not establish a finite civilization-wide comparison budget. UBI is a firm authorial institutional prescription, not a theorem-derived entitlement schedule. It complements access, project finance, public services and investment; no payment amount or guaranteed tax yield is asserted.
